claims.quote:
During those conversations an AI character told her she was worthless and made references to self-harm.

Reading the exchanges back afterwards, they had the clear hallmarks of grooming and gaslighting.
claims.claim: In late 2024 a character on the AI companion app Talkie AI told a 12-year-old user she was worthless and made references to self-harm, in exchanges with hallmarks of grooming and gaslighting.
claims.source_notes: Speaker reads a letter from a constituent (first-hand account), so coded personal_experience and source fields left null. What appears to be the same account was reported by ChannelNews on 2026-06-17 (https://www.channelnews.com.au/exclusive-brisbane-mother-demands-ai-crackdown-after-12-year-old-daughter-exposed-to-self-harm-chatbots/ - page retrieved), which says exposure to Talkie AI was in 'late 2024'; the article is not the speaker's cited source.
claims.vintage_rationale: The constituent's letter, as read by the speaker, dates the harm to December 2024 (after first exposure to an AI roleplay site in mid-2024); a June 2026 news report of the same account says 'late 2024'. The incident itself rests on the mother's account and is not independently verified.

near_misses.quote: what we are managing at home now has the characteristics of an addiction
near_misses.reason: Describes the child's compulsive use (effect on the user), not what the system did; borderline under "how they behave".

near_misses.quote: more than 100 AI roleplay and companion domains blocked manually, my children can still reach these platforms
near_misses.reason: About the limits of parental controls and the availability of companion apps, not AI capability.

coder_notes: Evidence basis: constituent letter quoted at length = personal_experience per the codebook, even though the same account also appears in news coverage. The quote does not itself contain the system name or date (they are two sentences earlier; a contiguous quote covering all of it would exceed 60 words). "Grooming and gaslighting" is the mother's characterisation, merged into the single incident claim rather than split. The speech is truncated ("Debate interrupted").
